why: The 25 base BIM vault strategies pay whoever calls harvest(address) (0x0e5c011e, caller passes itself) a priority fee in WETH. 35 harvest events in the last 7 days (topic0 0x9bc239f1724cacfb88cb1d66a2dc437467699b68a8c90d7b63110cf4b6f92410 over blocks 55758817-58782817); 32 of the 35 were called by EOA 0x558079b5f12b9c8d6119bfa5e7b7a58ba05dc579 (eth_getCode = 0x, a stranger bot, not a protocol contract) and every one of the 35 transferred a token to the keeper argument. Example: 0xd27e51f51eeea587facbdba7ae558fd0561ff176bc62adf3b31ec78f34495247 (block 58686147, strategy 0xBFeF6e2FE9E866Ddc0E7929ddb6CFB6E15313Bd3) paid 10440709580544 wei WETH = $0.0187 and used 1,337,758 gas at 6.00 gwei = $0.0144.
next_steps: Contract: each BIM strategy (EIP-1167 clone of 0x6e74b45ee00694c3e5d93f4262bd8c9fca48cbbd), function harvest(address) 0x0e5c011e with the caller's own address; only the vault is excluded from the fee. 7-day count 35 calls (~5/day) across 9 active strategies; gross per call $0.00002-$0.0187 (mean $0.0052, all in WETH), gas 0.83-1.48M gas per call = $0.009-$0.031 (mean $0.0164, ETH $1791.89 from coins.llama.fi at 2026-11-17). Only 7 of 32 keeper calls (all on aero-msusd-usdc strategy 0xBFeF6e2FE9E866Ddc0E7929ddb6CFB6E15313Bd3, gross $0.0184 vs gas $0.0147 = +$0.0036) beat their gas: 7-day totals gross $0.17 vs gas $0.53, net -$0.36 for the keeper. Nobody contests it (one caller, ~5 harvests/day, so no first-block race), but the whole base opportunity is ~2 cents a day: a bot only breaks even if it harvests the 0xBFeF6e2F strategy and nothing else, or if the keeper runs this across many protocols.
